note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law, and every route status is shown only as supplied. Reaching the tray means only that a route delivered its capsule to the point of analysis — no conclusion is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional guest-pass rule with two alternative routes (a member's written invitation, a partner-club card). Both facts are supplied: each clerk sends a capsule through their own tube; both land in the same tray; the magnifier swings over it.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library-fee waiver with a different pair of routes. Route A's fact is supplied as DISPUTED (its capsule is stopped at the check gate with a question disc) while Route B's fact is supplied; only Route B reaches the tray. Other clerks, two assumptions and an editorial note on the junction.

rules.name: Library rule 9 (fictional text): a late fee may be looked at again by either route
conditions: The book was returned through the night slot
A staff member recorded a desk extension

facts.label: Night-slot log shows the book at 23:10 on Day 14
Desk note: extension recorded by staff member R. Osei

issues: Which clock does the night-slot log use?
assumptions: The slot log and the desk notes are complete
Hypothetical fee; no amount is decided here

annotations.text: Either inlet can open the one outlet

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names and texts near the field limits: long rule caption, long conditions and facts, long clerk names and captions, two long assumptions and a long issue. Text wraps between words; sizes stay at or above 16 px at 1080p.

rules.name: Rule M-27 (fictional housing co-operative rule): a request to use the shared roof terrace may arrive by either route
conditions: The request is countersigned by two registered members of the housing co-operative board
The requester presents the stamped annual terrace permit issued by the caretaker's office

facts.label: Request form countersigned by board members Maria-Fernanda Castellanos and Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Clarke on Day 12
Annual terrace permit no. T-5561 stamped by the caretaker's office, shown at the stairwell door on Day 13

issues: Were both countersignatures added before the request was placed in the tube? (not examined here)
assumptions: Each route is read on its own and neither route is ranked above the other
The dates are taken from the documents as supplied; none of them is verified here

actorLabels.a: sends the countersigned request by Route A
actorLabels.b: sends the terrace permit copy by Route B
